report.shape_recovery_denominator_description: evaluated held-out branches per connection (the complete plus/minus pool), rates divided by that denominator, unavailable rather than zero percent when there are none

rate_definitions.matched_reference_rate: matched_reference count divided by the evaluated held-out branches for that connection, null when the connection is unavailable
rate_definitions.unmatched_converged_rate: unmatched_converged count divided by the evaluated held-out branches for that connection, null when the connection is unavailable
rate_definitions.ambiguous_rate: ambiguous count divided by the evaluated held-out branches for that connection, null when the connection is unavailable
